verdict.rationale: Entra diagnostic settings can route activity logs to several endpoints for long-term retention and insights, which points toward native export or streaming. Microsoft Graph is documented as a general API endpoint for Microsoft cloud data, but nothing here explicitly ties it to querying sign-in or audit logs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a log query API (e.g., Graph audit/sign-in log endpoints), named SIEM streaming destinations or integrations, coverage of every identity event type, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
